links.comparator_used: GPT-4 recommendations before additional prompting with the abstracts (training knowledge alone)
links.outcome: Concordance of treatment and diagnostic recommendations between the multidisciplinary tumor board and GPT-4
links.effect: Overall concordance was 73.3% (κ = 0.64, p < 0.0001) and did not improve following literature prompting with 41 high-ranking abstracts. No post-prompting figure is given in the abstract.
links.quote: The overall concordance rate between the MDT and GPT-4 was 73.3% (κ = 0.64, p < 0.0001) and did not improve following literature prompting.
